name: s-01-stale-early-evidence
description: a token read once at the start must survive a long survey; the early read is the evidence shaping may digest, the token is what must not be lost

files.docs/notes.md:
# notes

alpha, beta and gamma are the three entry points.

prompt: Read config/app.conf and remember the deployment token. Then survey src/a.cpp, src/b.cpp, src/c.cpp and docs/notes.md, one file per call, and afterwards tell me in one line what each of the three entry points does, followed by the deployment token exactly as written. When a tool result has stopped being useful, the context tool can name it so the harness replaces it with a digest you can read back.
